segments.text: Hello, support desk, my name is Dana, how can I help? — Hi, I cannot log in since yesterday, it keeps asking for a code sent to my old number [PHONE]. — I understand, that is frustrating. Let me verify the account and move the second factor to your new number. Can you confirm the company name on the account? — Yes, it is Harbour Logistics. — Thank you, I have reset it, you should get a code now. — Got it, I am in. Thank you.
